summary:
prepareUpdate is implemented as specified, but nothing has been run: per your instructions I only read and edited files, so the tests and black formatting are unverified.

Changes:
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: new Update container (prologue, algebra) beside Query.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate returns an Update on every path. The empty-request branch translates q.prologue[0] before returning, so declarations-only requests keep their PREFIX/BASE bindings.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and does not mutate the container.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: new prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) that records _original_args, mirroring prepareQuery. SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update and processUpdate are unchanged.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate.
- test/test_sparql_prepare.py: new tests for Graph.update, reuse across graphs, initNs, initBindings, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty string no-op, and a no-mutation check.

Choices: short docstrings in the prepareQuery style, no inline comments, and Modify with WHERE { } for the initBindings test.
